server/pipeline.description: The six-stage trading pipeline — Analysts, Debate, Trader, Risk, Verdict, Execution — plus the post-trade feedback loop that adjusts analyst weights and risk thresholds.

server/apps.description: The three long-running processes: orchestrator (ticks the pipeline), service-api (serves the dashboard), supervisor (process lifecycle and restart).

server/providers.description: External data sources behind stable interfaces — market data (OHLCV/indicators), universe pool selection, and market intelligence (news/sentiment).

server/shared.description: Cross-cutting utilities imported by nearly every server module — logging, clocks, trace context, digests, and the store abstraction.

server/tools.description: Standalone CLI scripts run via npm — backtests, cost/CGT reports, live-money gate checks, the arch viewer itself.

contracts.description: The wire model shared by server and client — pipeline stages, snapshots, metrics, provider types — owned by neither runtime, imported by both.

client/src.description: The Rail v3 dashboard — the live-trading UI: tabs, lanes, verdict rows, trace and trade detail drawers.

client/public.description: Static assets served as-is by the client build.

docs.description: ADRs, research, specs, wayfinder maps, and review reports — the project's decision record and domain glossary.

e2e.description: Playwright end-to-end suite for the dashboard, run against the real built server over a fixture store.
